items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Lucille Hagan, she had an act patterned after Mamie Smith... She's a nice looking light-complected woman, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Lucille Hagan, she had an act patterned after Mamie Smith and everybody else, a blues act, you know, and you know, like, "Aggravatin' Papa, Don't You Two-Time Me," and all that stuff. She's a nice looking light-complected woman, you know.
